verdict.rationale: Dynadot's security page documents an optional Registry Lock, which covers the 'domains that must never move' half of the story. It also mentions an account lock, but nothing shows a domain-level transfer lock applied by default. missing for 10: evidence of a default-on registrar transfer lock (clientTransferProhibited) on domains, details on how Registry Lock works (eligible TLDs, unlock verification), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, my domains can be locked down — transfer lock by default and a registry-lock option for the domains that must never move

citations.quote: Dynadot offers free domain privacy, account lock, two-factor authentication, and optional Registry Lock to keep your online assets safe.
